title: Not super quality, but will work okay
text: Not super quality, but will work okay. Wish it was heavier and that the edges were finished more professionally. Arrived very wrinkled - put it in the dryer for a few minutes and that helped.

product_metadata.title: Summer Fun (Elrene) Seashells, Seahorses and Coral (White on Ocean Blue) Vinyl Flannel Back Tablecloth (52" x 52" Square)
features: Easy Care- Wipe Clean with Damp Cloth
Fits table sizes 28" x 28" to 40" x 40".
description: Elrene tablecloth is 100% vinyl with 100% olefin flannel backing. A collage of a variety of seashells, seahorses and coral gives the feel of the ocean and the sea shore in any room or area. Vinyl tablecloth allows for easy care - just wipe clean with damp cloth or sponge.
